excerpt.zh: 反叛的渣滓。这种背叛的行为不会被忘记的。
excerpt.en: Rebel scum. This act of treachery will not soon be forgotten.

texts.zh: 反叛的渣滓。这种背叛的行为不会被忘记的。
texts.en: Rebel scum. This act of treachery will not soon be forgotten.

texts.zh: 你们这群愚蠢的家伙胆敢违抗[From.GetRulerTitle]。现在你们都得付出代价了。
texts.en: You were fools to revolt against the [From.GetRulerTitle]. Now you have paid the price.

texts.zh:
帝国没有叛乱的立足之地。你最好给我记清楚这点。

[From.GetRulerTitle]万岁！
texts.en:
Sedition will never be tolerated within the Imperium. You would do well to remember that.

Long live the [From.GetRulerTitle]!

texts.zh: 对[From.GetRulerTitle]的反对是徒劳的。接受你是这一个更伟大整体一部分的角色吧。
texts.en: Future opposition to the [From.GetRulerTitle] is futile. Accept your role within the greater whole.
